hero.name: Mustafa Ahmad
hero.bio: I build practical web applications, administrative systems, and business platforms using Laravel, PHP, React, and JavaScript. I enjoy transforming real-world requirements into clean, simple, and maintainable software.

about.title: A developer who loves building real-world projects
about.p1: I am Mustafa Ahmad, a Full-Stack Web Developer from Egypt, working primarily with Laravel, PHP, React, and JavaScript.
about.p2: I focus on developing web applications, admin dashboards, and systems built around real business needs, emphasizing clean code, deep understanding of system mechanics, and continuous refinement of my software craftsmanship.
about.p3: I have worked on projects for real clients, alongside personal projects used to explore new technologies and software engineering fundamentals.

process.title: My Development Approach
process.subtitle: A structured, progressive workflow that turns real problems into resilient software.

steps.title: Understand
steps.desc: I start by thoroughly grasping the problem and real requirements before writing any code.

steps.title: Plan
steps.desc: I divide the system into clear components, define how they function, and map their relationships.

steps.title: Build
steps.desc: I develop the application incrementally, focusing on required functionality, code clarity, and ease of future maintenance.

steps.title: Test
steps.desc: I verify critical paths and core operations to catch bugs early and preserve system stability.

steps.title: Refactor & Improve
steps.desc: I regularly revisit and refine code structure as the application matures and scales.

beyondCode.title: Lifelong Learning
beyondCode.subtitle: To me, programming is far more than just syntax.
beyondCode.philosophyTitle: Programming is not just writing lines of code; it's engineering sustainable, integrated solutions.
beyondCode.p1: I genuinely love understanding how systems work under the hood, exploring different ways to solve problems, experimenting with new tools, and learning from hurdles encountered during real development.
beyondCode.p2: Every project is an opportunity to improve something new—whether in code structure, system architecture, workflow efficiency, or deeper comprehension of the problem itself.

pillars.title: Deep Systems Understanding
pillars.desc: Focusing on how components interact end-to-end from database to UI, avoiding superficial fixes.

pillars.title: Continuous Architecture Evolution
